findings.title: Integrated check passed despite recorded source drift during the run
findings.message: This record shows a canonical source file (specs/accessibility.md) changed while the integrated check ran, so the check's pass (check_exit 0) does not clearly describe the final source tree. The record does not say whether the check was rerun afterwards. current-capture-proof.json separately reports changed_canonical_files_after_capture as empty, so a reader cannot tell which claim applies to the final source.
findings.suggestion: Rerun the integrated check against a frozen tree and regenerate the report with an empty drift list. If the drift is intentional, state in the report which snapshot it applies to and why accessibility.md does not affect the result.
